hypothesis: A very small PPO continuation from the M163 boundary-outcome actor update can improve or retain broad obstacle behavior while preserving the M164 boundary replay signal.
success_criteria: run only a short guarded PPO smoke before any long training
keep actor inputs unchanged and do not expose M162 labels or hidden parameters
include action-retention or low-learning-rate controls to avoid washing out M163
pass behavior retention against M156/M163 on zero-relvel obstacle seeds
rerun M164 boundary-outcome replay gate after PPO
state whether longer PPO is admitted
failure_criteria: start a large PPO continuation directly
accept PPO based on training reward without M164 replay retention
erase wrong-history degradation on the fixed M162 boundary rows
feed oracle labels or hidden dynamics to the actor

commands.name: m165_guarded_ppo_smoke
commands.command: Run a short PPO continuation from M163 and gate it with behavior, protected-key, and M164 boundary replay checks.

decision_rule: Admit longer PPO only if the smoke checkpoint passes behavior retention, protected key replay, and the M164 fixed boundary replay gate.
